source_refs.note: ii) Alkaline Earth Metals: a main subheading of 1.5 Families in the periodic table, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 5-5.

blocks.text: Group 2 ke elements metals hain jo zyada tar earth (zameen) mein milte hain aur alkalis banate hain, is liye inhein alkaline earth metals kehte hain. Misal: calcium aur magnesium. In ke valence shell mein do electrons hote hain, is liye yeh divalent (do bond banane wale) hain. Yeh solid metals hain jo alkali metals se zyada sakht aur zyada dense hain. Yeh asani se oxidize ho jate hain aur heat aur electricity (bijli) achhi tarah guzarte hain.
